title: Adaptive runtime policy catalog, phase-transition schedule, and provenance work item
summary: Add the measurement-only policy catalog, deterministic campaign schedules, and append-only dataset provenance controls needed for offline adaptive-runtime measurement while keeping production behavior unchanged.
planned_changes:
- Add a versioned policy-catalog seam that records safe-seam policy candidates and keeps the catalog measurement-only.
- Add deterministic phase-transition schedule artifacts and workload shapes for controlled few-to-many-to-few and regime-shift campaigns, with stable IDs and exact command lineage.
- Add explicit missingness and join handling plus append-only raw, normalized, curated, and split pipeline enforcement with reason codes and provenance checks.
- Add focused requirement-home, replay, and provenance validation before any later implementation slice can widen the measurement contract.
- Keep the work limited to review-only metadata, offline campaign artifacts, and trace alignment; do not introduce active policy application.
verification_plan: Validate the touched SpecTrace artifacts individually and verify their direct links; prove the catalog remains non-authoritative; prove deterministic phase-transition schedules replay with the same treatment order and command lineage; prove join failures, missing rows, and excluded rows retain explicit reason codes; prove raw, normalized, curated, and split layers are append-only; prove provenance reaches repository state, binary hashes, workload shape, policy values, source artifacts, and transformation version; and keep all active-controller and production-activation paths out of scope.
out_of_scope: Applying any adaptive runtime policy in production
Using workload labels, scenario names, or benchmark identifiers as runtime controller inputs
Online learning, production exploration, or self-updating thresholds
Destructive dataset curation that deletes retained evidence
Widening any policy axis beyond the measurement-only catalog
